rule: Appended beside the receipts; no receipt is rewritten. This annex labels what each P246 result is evidence OF. Preserved results stand; their evidentiary status is corrected where the label overstated.

sharedCaveat.holdoutReuse: Every P246 evaluation scored the 2025 season, which was already the champion evaluations' held-out season and whose per-family metrics and calibration curves had been inspected before the P246 candidates were designed. Candidate SELECTION happened strictly inside 2023-24 train in each case, which bounds — but does not eliminate — the leakage: the diagnosis that motivated each candidate came from looking at 2025 failures. 2025 is therefore a REUSED evaluation season, not a fresh holdout. The next genuinely untouched evidence for these heads is the 2026 season now underway (forward, walk-forward, bars already frozen).
sharedCaveat.consequence: No promotion is voided — each bar was frozen before its evaluation ran, and selection stayed in-train. But no P246 result may be described as 'proven on unseen data' without this qualifier, and 2026 forward performance is the deciding evidence.

matchup-totals-v1-decayed-points.pointEstimate: held-out 2025 mean NLL 4.02898 vs refit shared prior 4.04898
matchup-totals-v1-decayed-points.honestReading: The candidate met its preregistered bar (mean NLL strictly below the prior) and its train slope is strongly significant (a1 = 0.784 ± 0.172, ~4.6 sigma), but the HELD-OUT improvement is a modest point estimate whose 95% interval includes zero — 285 games cannot separate a 0.02-nat gain from noise. This is 'cleared its bar with a real in-sample mechanism', not 'proven better out of sample'. Public prose already claims only that it beat the prior under preregistered bars, which is the point estimate and stays accurate; nothing may escalate that to a significance claim.
matchup-totals-v1-decayed-points.forwardEvidence: 2026 weekly settlement grades every published total against the frozen forecast — that accumulating record is the fresh evidence.

caveats: Gamma selected at the FROZEN grid's boundary (0.90, monotone through the grid) — the in-train optimum may lie lower; already recorded in the verdict receipt. Any wider grid is a new candidate on development data with a new frozen rule, never a re-search against the same season.

The one-sided miscalibration that motivated the candidate was diagnosed on 2025 held-out curves before the candidate existed; the train-visible confirmation (2024 walk-forward, measurement-only lane) is what makes the train-fit correction admissible, but the 2025 bar evaluation is a second look at an inspected season.

pass-gamesigma-pooled-mean-v1.caveat: The rejection is the strongest-evidenced P246 result (the candidate failed against the bar it was designed to clear). Its center-error diagnosis derives from 2025 residual structure and counts as development knowledge for any successor candidate — a successor's bars must freeze before ITS evaluation, and 2025 remains a reused season for it too.
